product.title: Orlando Tree Trek Adventure Park

description.text: Take the excitement of your Orlando vacation up a level with a tree top adventure. This ropes course is a series of aerial adventures with cargo nets, swinging logs, ziplines, trapeze swings and other obstacles to challenge yourself. Every level of climbing expertise will find something to test their skills, on a thrilling course set from 10 to 50 feet (3 to 15 meters) above the ground.Spend 2-3 hours challenging yourself on the ropes course This adventure is a thrill for the whole family (ages 7 years and older) Conveniently located near the Walt Disney World Resort. Ideal for travelers basing in Orlando who want a guided Florida experience beyond the theme parks without coordinating boats, gear, or launch times on their own.
